<!-- pr-reviewer: 9135ccbb803c61b9041760d8f6571678f2a12516 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one process item; the code is sound).

**What looks good**
- `set_operation_setup` and `delete_setup` run the existing `SetOperationSetup` / `DeleteSetup` commands through History: one undo step each, validation at command creation, refusals are the commands' own text (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:100-122`). No unwrap/expect/panic added.
- `setup` is required, so an omitted value is refused instead of read as "first position".
- Pinning tests sit in `crates/app/tests/` and import app commands, so placement is right. Decision entry present, no new crate dependency, no snapshot PNGs, no GUI files, `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #731` present. `setup_tools.rs` is 379 lines.
- Safety floor: it moves operations between setups, which can change posted output. It reuses the existing commands and the staleness law reports the moved operation's status, so nothing is posted silently.

**Local results** (PR head, trial-merged with main, which was already up to date; sccache on)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `mcp_setup_moves` | 2 passed |
| `mcp_setup` | 8 passed |
| `mcp_setup_mount_trace` | 3 passed |
| `mcp_wire_contour` | 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 49, but main is 46, so the value must be 47 (main + 1). The PR changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, so it needs the bump. The body's reasoning (other open PRs hold 47/48) is understood, but the rule is main + 1, and whichever PR merges second renumbers anyway. Set it to 47 and fix the matching line in `docs/decisions/731-mcp-setup-moves.md`.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Undo of `DeleteSetup` restores the setup at the end of the list, not its old position (as the body observes). A follow-up issue could cover it.
- The `status` lookup in `set_operation_setup` matches by key or label; fine for now.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fix for the review item at 9135ccbb, now at 288bf57f.
- **PROCESS_VERSION:** I merged main (now at 48), and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 49, which is main + 1. The matching line in `docs/decisions/731-mcp-setup-moves.md` is corrected.
- **The undo-order note:** it was not a defect. Setups list in name order, so undo puts a deleted setup back in place; #1362 covers it, pinned by #1364 (merged). `mcp_setup_moves` now asserts that order directly, with no `sort()`.
- **Results:** `mcp_setup_moves` 2/2 and `mcp_setup` 8/8 pass, and clippy is clean.
Ready for a re-check; `needs-rework` is left for the reviewer.

Refreshed onto main at 4958b5f5.
- **Conflicts resolved:** two.
  - `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is now 51 (main + 1). The body and the decision file say so.
  - The `setup_tools.rs` import list keeps both this PR's `DeleteSetup`/`SetOperationSetup` and main's `SetProgramInfo`.
- **Tests:** `mcp_setup_moves` 2, `mcp_setup` 9 and `program_info` 10 pass, and clippy is clean.
- **File size:** `setup_tools.rs` is now 414 lines (main's `set_program` plus this PR's two tools); a split is worth a follow-up.
Ready for a re-check.

@NeoTech: re-check request. Your 04:28Z item (the PROCESS_VERSION bump) is addressed at `4958b5f5`: it is now 51, main + 1. A collaborator review at this head is clean. The `needs-rework` label is yours to clear.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4958b5f51f5f77b5c0f0be5c74f1321f51c6b645 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Re-review of the new head 4958b5f5; the earlier `needs-rework` item is addressed.

**Earlier request, re-checked**
- The PROCESS_VERSION bump is present (51, with the matching line in `docs/decisions/731-mcp-setup-moves.md`). `origin/main` has since moved to 51 as well, so at merge time the PR's value needs renumbering to main + 1. That is a merge-time refresh matter, not a blocker.

**What looks good**
- `set_operation_setup` and `delete_setup` build the existing `SetOperationSetup::new` / `DeleteSetup::new` (validation at command creation) and run them through `env.history.execute`: one undo step each (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:101-123`). No unwrap/expect/panic. `setup` is required, so an omitted value is refused, not read as "first position".
- Refusals are the commands' own text as tool errors; undo/redo of both is pinned in `crates/app/tests/mcp_setup_moves.rs` (right crate, Gate map present, no `sort()` on the order check).
- Skill rows, decision file, `Changelog:`, `Fixes #731` present. No snapshot PNGs, build.rs, .github, scripts, dependency or CHANGELOG.md changes.

**Local results** (PR head trial-merged with current main, clean merge)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `mcp_setup_moves` | 2 passed |
| `mcp_setup` | 9 passed |
| `mcp_setup_mount_trace` | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `setup_tools.rs` is 414 lines (over ~400 only because of main's `set_program` plus these two tools); a split along the setup-placement / program-info seam is a good follow-up.
- Process file changed (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`), so the PROCESS_VERSION renumber at merge applies.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merge-time refresh: merged main and set PROCESS_VERSION to 52 (main had taken 51). Class: MECHANICAL - hand edit only in .claude/PROCESS_VERSION; the review at 4958b5f5 stands.
